title: clerodendrum tatei
intro: Clerodendrum tatei, commonly known as the "Thai Borage", is a tropical plant species native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Clerodendrum tatei include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a valuable natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of Clerodendrum tatei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
